meta.home.title: bb-system — coaching, tracked
banner.beta: bb-system is in beta. Testing is by invitation.
home.hero.line: A coach and the person they coach, sharing training, diet, check-ins and progress in one tracked conversation.
home.student.title: For the student
home.student.p1: Today's training, diet and supplements, exactly as the coach wrote them.
home.student.p2: Log workouts with sets and loads, and the meals you actually ate.
home.student.p3: Send a daily check-in with photos, including what went wrong.
home.student.p4: Chat with your coach in one place.
home.coach.title: For the coach
home.coach.p1: Your assigned students and where each one stands.
home.coach.p2: Review check-ins and reply; new, seen and replied are always clear.
home.coach.p3: Protocols for diet, training and phytotherapy, published to the student's app.
home.coach.p4: The same chat, on your side.
home.progress.title: Progress stays tracked
home.progress.p1: Evolution over time: adherence, loads, measurements and health readings in one view.
home.progress.p2: Every check-in, reply and message is kept, so nothing gets lost in loose chats.
home.progress.p3: Offline-safe: what you type is saved on the device and sent when the connection returns.
home.beta.title: Join the beta
home.beta.p1: bb-system is under development and in alpha/beta testing. The iOS apps, BB Student and BB Coach, are distributed through TestFlight by invitation. An Android app for students is in testing as well.
home.beta.p2: Expect rough edges: screens change between builds, and the beta backend may be reset. Testers are told by e-mail before that happens.
home.beta.p3: To get an invitation, send an e-mail with the subject "bb-system beta" and say whether you are a coach or a student.
home.about.title: Who is behind it
home.about.p1: bb-system is built by ACF Labs. Questions, bug reports and privacy requests go to amadeu01@gmail.com.
meta.home.description: bb-system connects a coach and the person they coach: training, diet, check-ins and progress in one tracked conversation. In beta.
